name: NotebookLM Notes Renderer
description: Clean and structure raw NotebookLM markdown notes into sanitized, reusable documentation.
tagline: Clean parsing, structural sanitization, and professional visual export for raw NotebookLM markdown summaries and research notes.

about.title: What is this utility?
about.description: NotebookLM generates powerful AI research synopses, but raw exports frequently contain broken list hierarchies, unescaped tags, and non-standard block formatting. This utility sanitizes, formats, and renders raw notes into clean, responsive layout blocks ready for documentation and archiving.
about.projectNotice: Part of the Utilitorium workbench ecosystem

steps.title: Input Notes
steps.description: Paste your exported NotebookLM markdown or raw summary text into the left pane.

steps.title: Auto Process
steps.description: The sanitization engine normalizes headers, cleans artifacts, and renders live output.

steps.title: Copy or Save
steps.description: Copy clean HTML, download the markdown, or export clean styled PDFs.

# Executive Summary: Edge AI Sign Language Inference

## Core Findings
- **Kinematic Token Pruning:** Reduces redundant frames across temporal sequences by over **42%** without degrading accuracy.
- **Spatial-Temporal GCNs:** Effectively models multi-joint skeletal graph nodes across 2D/3D coordinate spaces.
- **Deterministic Grounding:** Output representations remain strictly tied to verified lexical tokens.

### Pipeline Architecture
> "A minimal tensor footprint in preprocessing dictates real-time latency viability on micro-accelerators."

1. **Landmark Extraction:** High-framerate frame ingestion.
2. **Graph Formulation:** Adjacency matrix construction across joints.
3. **Inference Execution:** Low-latency execution with INT8 precision.
